title.narrative: UNICEF advanced local climate resilience for children by training 704 children and adolescents as climate leaders to develop proposals with the private sector; integrating child-sensitive criteria in 42 municipalities through Municipal Emergency Committees; developing digital educational tools on climate change; and creating the new INFORM index with a climate change focus to support strategic decision-making.
